target: 100% completion of the original Japanese mobile release, including all 80 Operation Mode nodes, all 50 Scenario operations, every rank unlock, roster route, weapon, and item, spoiler-free

areas.name: Original Mobile Route
areas.location_cue: The Japanese feature-phone application manager, title menu, and first mission room.
areas.note: Preserve original data before testing the partially recovered modern route.

items.label: Use the Original Japanese Mobile Release

levels.1: The complete historical route depended on a carrier application.
levels.2: Run the original application on its supported Japanese feature-phone environment.
levels.3: Preserve the installed package and downloaded data together, clone the handset storage, verify Operation and Scenario menus load, and keep an untouched baseline because the retired service cannot restore missing data.

levels.1: More than one Japanese carrier received the game.
levels.2: Record whether the installation is the AU release or later i-mode edition.
levels.3: At the title screen and handset application manager, capture the carrier build, device model, application version, package size, and save-data date. Do not merge progress across builds until their unlock tables are proven identical.

levels.1: The accessible archival reconstruction is not the whole original release.
levels.2: If using the 2025 preservation build, mark it as partial before starting.
levels.3: Record the archival launcher and package hashes, test every visible mode, and keep its progress separate from original-device completion. The preservation reporting explicitly describes a partial recovery, so absent stages or server data remain verification holds.

levels.1: The keypad bindings can be changed.
levels.2: Test movement, aiming, interaction, firing, status, map, and menu inputs.
levels.3: In a safe opening operation, confirm the direction pad moves; while aiming it changes elevation or target; Confirm examines or fires; the right soft key toggles aim; and the left soft key opens the menu. Test the configured dash, status, and map keys before timed runs.

areas.name: Equipment and Item Archive
areas.location_cue: Operation loadouts, in-stage pickups, status screen, and post-mission records.
areas.note: Six weapons and three ordinary items are documented; one weapon slot and vitality set need original-build confirmation.

levels.1: A close-range fallback appears in the armory.
levels.2: Register the Knife in an operation loadout.
levels.3: Select an operation that supplies the Knife, equip it from status, land a confirmed hit, finish the objective, and verify the results retain the weapon entry. The exact first source node requires original-build verification.

levels.1: The basic firearm supports precision shots.
levels.2: Register the Handgun in an operation loadout.
levels.3: Equip the Handgun, use the raised-weapon reticle to land a critical hit, complete the active objective, and confirm the armory or result record. Its earliest unlock node remains build-dependent.

levels.1: One unlock covers a wider close-range arc.
levels.2: Register the Shotgun in an operation loadout.
levels.3: Acquire the Shotgun from a ranked unlock or stage supply, group nearby targets, fire within effective range, and finish the mission with it retained. Verify the weapon appears on later loadout screens.

levels.1: The strongest single-shot sidearm has heavy recoil.
levels.2: Register the Magnum in an operation loadout.
levels.3: Unlock or collect the Magnum, fire at a durable target from a stable position, allow the recoil animation to finish, and complete the objective. Check that the post-mission equipment record includes it.

levels.1: A sustained weapon trades fuel for rapid damage.
levels.2: Register the Flamethrower in an operation loadout.
levels.3: Obtain the Flamethrower through the rank progression, hold its stream on one target only long enough to confirm damage, conserve remaining fuel, finish the operation, and verify it remains available where the build permits.

levels.1: An explosive weapon controls clustered targets.
levels.2: Register the Grenade Launcher in an operation loadout.
levels.3: Unlock or collect the launcher, create distance before firing at a group, avoid wasting its limited ammunition, and complete the active operation. Confirm the result or armory records the weapon.

levels.1: Launch coverage reports seven weapons, while surviving lists name only six.
levels.2: Identify and register the seventh weapon on an original complete build.

levels.1: The smaller healing item restores part of the health bar.
levels.2: Use a Green Herb after losing at least forty percent health.
levels.3: Take controlled damage until the heal is not wasted, open status, consume the herb, and verify roughly two-fifths of the health bar returns. Finish the operation so the use is represented in the ledger.

levels.1: The larger healing item refills the health bar.
levels.2: Use a First Aid Spray while substantially injured.
levels.3: Lower health safely, consume the spray from status, and confirm the bar reaches full. Complete the mission after the test; reload a backup if the item is scarce and its use would obstruct the rank attempt.

levels.1: A utility pickup refills an empty weapon.
levels.2: Use Reserve Ammunition after depleting a firearm.
levels.3: Choose a repeatable stage, empty the selected gun without ending the objective, use Reserve Ammunition from status, and verify the weapon can fire again. Record the item before restoring the rank-cleanup save.

levels.1: Special pickups permanently enlarge survivability.
levels.2: Collect every vitality-increasing item and reach the build maximum.

save_backup.title: Use a disposable equipment test save
save_backup.why: Healing, ammunition, and rare weapon tests can damage a rank attempt.
